mapper.sql: select id, check_no, machinery_id, machinery_code, machinery_name, check_type, check_result, status, checker_id, checker_name, check_date, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from dv_check
mapper.select:
AND check_no like concat('%', #{checkNo}, '%')
AND machinery_code like concat('%', #{machineryCode}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into dv_check (check_no, machinery_id, machinery_code, machinery_name, check_type, check_result, status, checker_id, checker_name, check_date, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{checkNo}, #{machineryId}, #{machineryCode}, #{machineryName}, #{checkType}, #{checkResult}, #{status}, #{checkerId}, #{checkerName}, #{checkDate}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update dv_check set status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
